post.description:
Details, variants (sizes/colours) and per-variant price or stock of one product in a Tiendanube / Nuvemshop store, e.g. from a pasted product URL (/productos/<slug>/ or /produtos/<slug>/).

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

slug.description: Product slug (the last path segment of its URL); requires store. Pattern: ^[^/?#\s]+/?$.

store.description: The store: a bare domain (tienda.example.com, example.mitiendanube.com, example.lojavirtualnuvem.com.br) or any URL on it. Any Tiendanube / Nuvemshop storefront, including custom domains.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
One product from any Tiendanube / Nuvemshop store by product page URL (or store plus slug): id, name, description as text, brand, tags, breadcrumb categories, all image URLs, price and original (compare-at) price as decimals with currency, price-on-request flag, stock state and units when published, the variant options (size, colour...) and every variant with its id, option values, SKU, price, compare-at price, stock state, units when tracked and image.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | string |  |
| `categories` | object[] | Breadcrumb categories, outermost first. |
| `compare_at_price` | number | Original price of the displayed variant when on sale. |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `description` | string | Full description as plain text (line breaks kept); falls back to the page's schema.org description when the theme renders none. |
| `id` | number | Tiendanube product id. |
| `images` | string[] | Product image URLs (1024px renditions on the Tiendanube CDN). |
| `in_stock` | boolean | True when any variant can be bought. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `options` | object[] | Variant options (up to three) with every value offered. |
| `price` | number | Price of the displayed (default) variant; null when the store shows no price. |
| `price_on_request` | boolean |  |
| `sku` | string | SKU of the displayed (default) variant. |
| `slug` | string |  |
| `stock` | number | Total units in stock when the store publishes it; null for untracked stock. |
| `store` | object | The store that answered: the requested host and, when a storefront page was read, Tiendanube's store id, name and platform subdomain. |
| `tags` | string[] | Product tags the storefront publishes (LS.product.tags). |
| `url` | string | Canonical product page. |
| `variants` | object[] |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
Catalogue, new products (sort created-descending), prices or stock of a store on Tiendanube / Nuvemshop (*.mitiendanube.com, *.lojavirtualnuvem.com.br or a custom domain). Get category paths from list_categories and product details from get_product.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

category.description: One category: its path (/ropa/remeras/) or its URL on the store, from list_categories. Omit for the all-products listing.

page.description:
Page number (default 1); the page size is the store theme's.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500.

query.description: Keywords matched (accent-insensitive, every word) against product URL slugs from the store's sitemap. Cannot be combined with category or sort.

sort.description:
Storefront sort order; omit for the store's default. created-descending lists the newest products first; user is the store's featured order.

Provider reference: allowed values ["user", "price-ascending", "price-descending", "alpha-ascending", "alpha-descending", "created-ascending", "created-descending", "best-selling"].

store.description: The store: a bare domain (tienda.example.com, example.mitiendanube.com, example.lojavirtualnuvem.com.br) or any URL on it. Any Tiendanube / Nuvemshop storefront, including custom domains.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Products of any Tiendanube / Nuvemshop store, one storefront page at a time: the all-products listing or one category, with the store's sort orders (newest first, best-selling, price, name), or a keyword match. Keyword search does not use the store's search page (robots.txt disallows /search/): it matches the words against the product URL slugs in the store's sitemap and reads each matching product page (10 per page). Each product carries id, name, URL, SKU, brand, price and original (compare-at) price as decimals with currency, price-on-request flag, stock state and units when published, main image and category. Verifies the site is a Tiendanube store; otherwise fails with not_tiendanube_store.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `items` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | string |  |
| `category` | string | Category name: the listed category in category mode, the deepest breadcrumb category in keyword mode, null on the all-products listing. |
| `compare_at_price` | number | Original price when the product is on sale (higher than price); null otherwise or when the listing does not publish it. |
| `currency` | string | ISO 4217 code as the store publishes it (ARS, BRL, MXN, COP, CLP...). |
| `id` | number | Tiendanube product id. |
| `image` | string | Main image, 1024px rendition on the Tiendanube CDN. |
| `in_stock` | boolean | Whether the product can be bought now; null when the listing does not say (untracked stock on themes without variant data). |
| `name` | string |  |
| `price` | number | Decimal amount in the store's currency; null when the store publishes no price (contact for price). |
| `price_on_request` | boolean | True when the store shows no price ("consultar precio"). |
| `sku` | string |  |
| `stock` | number | Units in stock when the store publishes it (schema.org inventoryLevel); null for untracked stock. |
| `url` | string | Product page; pass to get_product. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
